summary: Iteration 137: BookFactory Pipeline Backend Testing. Tested all BookFactory endpoints for the new parallel book generation pipeline. 21/26 tests passed, 5 skipped (LLM tests skipped due to Emergent proxy authentication issue). Core functionality working: trim-sizes, compositions, book/start, composition resolver, validation, backward compatibility.

critical.issue: Emergent LLM proxy authentication failing - litellm.AuthenticationError: OpenAIException - Invalid API key. The emergentintegrations library is using custom_llm_provider='openai' for Claude models which causes authentication to fail.
critical.root_cause: In emergentintegrations/llm/chat.py line 110, when using Emergent key, it sets custom_llm_provider='openai' but the model is claude-sonnet-4-20250514. This causes LiteLLM to try OpenAI authentication for a Claude model.

minor.issue: Intermittent Supabase connection issues (httpx.RemoteProtocolError: Server disconnected) causing sporadic 500 errors

notes: Frontend testing not requested - backend only testing performed

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Emergent LLM proxy authentication for Claude models. The emergentintegrations library needs to be updated to properly handle Anthropic models when using Emergent keys.
Alternative: Consider using direct Anthropic API calls with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead of emergentintegrations for BookFactory LLM calls
Monitor Supabase connection stability - intermittent disconnections observed

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Emergent LLM proxy authentication failure for Claude models
reproduction_steps: 2. The emergentintegrations library detects sk-emergent- key prefix
3. It sets api_base to Emergent proxy and custom_llm_provider='openai'
4. LiteLLM tries to call Claude model through OpenAI-compatible endpoint
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: emergentintegrations/llm/chat.py line 110 sets custom_llm_provider='openai' for all non-Gemini models when using Emergent keys. This is incorrect for Anthropic models.
mitigation_options: Option 1: Update emergentintegrations library to handle Anthropic models correctly
Option 2: Use direct Anthropic API calls with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in book_factory.py
Option 3: Use litellm directly with proper model prefix (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514)
